Sweep 1.4-1.8 on the live model: CAGR flat (21.0-21.4%), Martin and maxDD improve monotonically as the budget tightens. Gate vs v9.1.1: centre -0.02pp (flat), Martin up on all four arms (+0.06..+0.39), maxDD +2.01pp N=6 / +0.88pp N=16, every cadence D6 line improves. Prompted by March/July 2026 (books at ~1.9x market vol). The active-risk budget (1.05x vs a world index) is unchanged. Preserve keeps 1.8 (1.6 blocked on D6 cohorts behind). Devon 2026-11-07.
